Projects.Name: AutoVer
ChangelogMessages: Add --project-name to `version --current`, so one project's version can be captured from a repository that has several: VERSION=$(autover version --current --project-name "My Image") prints a bare value however many projects are configured. Previously only a single-project repository produced capturable output - with several, --current prints them labeled, which is readable but not assignable to a variable

An unknown --project-name is an error that lists the configured project names, rather than empty output. Left unvalidated, a typo in a pipeline would set VERSION="" and publish an untagged or mis-tagged artifact
Naming a project whose Paths have drifted to different versions is an error rather than a silent pick of the first, since those files are configured to share one version
The name matches the same way `change --project-name` does: exact and case-sensitive
